frequency_question: How often do labor union federations with demonstrated organizational capability and explicit strike intent follow through with an indefinite strike within a designated short window?
membership_rule: Includes industry-wide or nationwide union coalitions in large economies that have formally voted for and announced strike action; excludes single-employer localized strikes or flash walkouts without federation-level coordination.
window: A 12-day forward-looking response window following a formal strike call.

cases.name: All India Bank Employees Association strike (Jan 2020)
Public Sector Undertaking Unions coordinated strike (Nov 2022)

coverage_note: 7 named major federation strike calls in the regional banking and public sector context; believed to capture the primary relevant reference class.
known_gaps: Does not account for last-minute conciliation settlements mediated by labor ministries, which belong to external institutional variables rather than internal will and capability.
skeleton: Multi-year sample of announced major federation strike notices in the banking/public sector over a 5-year tracking period, divided into realized vs deferred/withdrawn notices.
multiplier: 4 hits out of 7 recorded formal escalation notices = 57 percent historical baseline follow-through rate.
validity_reason: Labor federation strike dynamics and bargaining structures remain stable over multi-year periods barring major labor law overhauls.
